question:
Among the drivers who participated in the French Grand Prix, who has the slowest time in the 3rd lap.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: slowest time refers to Max(time);

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_035, d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.XCL_043 = r.XCL_065
JOIN drivers d ON lt.XCL_044 = d.XCL_034
WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND lt.XCL_045 = 3
ORDER BY lt.XCL_048 DESC
LIMIT 1;
